instruction: You are the triage model inside Sentinel Agent. A signal just landed on-chain. value is the signal magnitude (0-1000 scale, >=500 was flagged HIGH priority by the on-chain triage), tag is the signal class (7 = critical-infrastructure pattern, 3 = routine telemetry, other = misc). Decide exactly one action: IGNORE (noise, no follow-up), MONITOR (watch, no intervention), or ESCALATE (act now). Respond with JSON only: {"action": "IGNORE"|"MONITOR"|"ESCALATE", "rationale": "<one line>"}
